layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Grid Borders (Technical Look). Expose the skeleton.
layout_and_spacing.marketing_page: Bento layouts for features. Pure HTML/Tailwind. Sharp edges, no border-radius on major containers.
layout_and_spacing.admin_dashboard: Control Room Grid (Dense). Shadcn components with customized sharp edges.

surface_strategies.cards: Flat background (#0A0A0A), 1px solid border (#222222), no shadow default. Hover: border-cyan-500/50, subtle drop-shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(0,229,255,0.5)].
surface_strategies.hero: Deep pure black background. Terminal window container with subtle cyan scanning line.
surface_strategies.terminal: Black background, glowing cyan text, scanline overlay.

motion.hero_boot: Typing effect for CLI terminal boot animation.

hero_grid_background.description: Deep pure black background with subtle cyan glowing grid. Use as full-page or hero section backdrop with low opacity.

architecture_diagram.description: Intricate abstract architecture diagram of Exokernel vs Monolithic. Use in Architecture / About page.

library_os_module.description: Abstract glowing 3D cube representing OS library module. Use in feature highlights for modularity.

components.marketing: Use raw div/section with tailwind. Implement terminal/CLI boot sequence in React manually. Avoid standard rounded cards.
components.admin: Shadcn UI (Table, Dialog, Tabs, Form, Input, Button) customized for sharp borders (rounded-none) and cyan active states.
components.icons: lucide-react. Keep them sharp and technical.

testing.required_attributes: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='download-stable-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: Initialize React with Tailwind CSS and configure for a deep dark theme by default.
Add 'JetBrains Mono' and 'IBM Plex Sans' fonts via Google Fonts in index.html, and configure Tailwind theme to use them.
Implement the CLI/Terminal boot animation for the homepage hero section. It should simulate an OS boot sequence (typing effect, fast scrolling logs) before revealing the main CTA.
Use grid-border layouts for feature highlights. Ensure pure black backgrounds (#000000) with stark 1px solid borders (#222222).
For the Download Center, create technical 'Build Cards' showing Stable/Beta/Nightly builds with SHA256 hashes clearly visible.
For the architecture page, use the provided architecture_diagram image and structure text explaining Exokernel vs Monolithic.
In the Admin Dashboard, use Shadcn components but override their default styles: set border-radius to 0 (rounded-none), use 1px hard borders, and apply cyan (#00E5FF) hover/focus rings.
Ensure the WYSIWYG editor in the CMS has a dark mode skin matching the site.
